text:
alex: Ugh — neighbor decided tonight is the perfect time for band practice. Drums through my wall at 8am. Anyone have quick WFH noise-damp tips? (posted a pic of my sad desk setup) <https://files.slack.com/archives/random/F12345ABC/IMG_20260322.jpg>
maria: Oof. I moved my desk into the walk-in closet for a week once. Big heavy blanket hung on an ikea curtain rod damped a TON. :thumbsup:
jamal: Second the closet move. Alternatively, get cheap window plugs (foam) for the sill — blocks a surprising amount of low end.
olivia: Also Zoom trick: use a directional mic + set "Suppress background noise" to High. If you're on USB mic, try noise gate in your audio settings or use Krisp/NoiseTorch.
alex: Nice — didn't think of the gate. Any cheap mic recs? My laptop mic is just sad.
ton: I use a Samson Q2U and a little foam pop filter. Budget but night-and-day vs built-in. Also a small area rug + bookcases against the wall helps.
alex: Router question unrelated but related: when the neighbor starts streaming the band, my wifi also starts choking (zoom lag). Any quick mesh or channel suggestions?
jamal: Quick: switch laptop to 5GHz, move router up off the floor, reboot modem+router for 30s. If that doesn't help, a cheap mesh or using your phone as hotspot for the call can save you in a pinch.
olivia: Powerline adapters can work if your house wiring is decent. If you want a short-term software hack, lower Zoom video to 360p and turn off HD. Audio > Advanced > use original sound for music if you're trying to stream, but for meetings enable suppression
deploy-bot: Scheduled tip drop: "If your house has a single thick wall between you and noise source, dense textiles (blankets/curtains) + soft furniture placements yield the best bang-for-buck." :robot_face:
alex: Going to try closet + rug tonight and maybe pick up a Q2U. Will post before/after pics — thanks everyone! :grin:
maria: Excited for the reveal. Don't forget to label the rug so the cat doesn't claim it immediately. :cat:
olivia: If you still have issues after that, ping me and I can share my Zoom audio presets.
